> 第81章 赵伯的忠告（第1页）
剑穗传讯后的第三天傍晚，秦川正在工作间里比对沈青黛送来的第三批凡人可用药材清单，怀中的剑穗忽然再次发热。这一次不是赵伯的声音——是珠子上浮现出一行极淡的金色小字，字迹潦草，像是匆忙间用手指直接写在光面上的。
“有人在查你的来历。不止一方。小心。”
秦川盯着这行字看了很久。赵伯的因果网已经碎了七成，能隔着千里之遥传递这么具体的信息，意味着老人动用了仅存的核心禁制。这条信息的分量不言而喻。
他放下药材清单，走到窗前。药田里暮色渐沉，几个晚归的弟子提着灯笼穿过田埂，笑声隐约可闻。百草谷的表面和平依然维持着，但赵伯的这条信息让他意识到——自己的信息差优势正在被对手反过来利用。
他在明，敌在暗。对方在查他的来历。但对方想知道的不是秦川是谁——而是秦川背后站着谁。老陆的记名弟子、钱不缺的甲级客户、百草谷谷主的特聘研究员——这些身份每一重都是保护，但每一重也都是一种信息的泄露。对手只需要将他所有的保护层逐一剥离，就能反推出他真正的底牌：一个不属于这个世界的灵魂，以及体内封印着终焉碎片的容器。
秦川走到桌前，摊开一张新的草纸，开始罗列可能正在调查他的势力。
第一方：丹堂长老沈鹤眠。动机最直接——秦川的存在动摇了丹堂在百草谷的学术权威。沈青黛的研究方向因为秦川的指导而获得突破性进展，这让沈鹤眠在外孙女面前既欣慰又尴尬。他有能力通过丹堂的渠道暗中调查秦川的来历，但也正因如此，他反而是最不危险的一方——他的调查一定不会触及轮回剑主和钱不缺的底线，因为他承受不起触怒那两位的后果。
第二方：天医宗内部反对柳玄的势力。柳玄在闭幕宴上接受秦川的合作提议，对天医宗来说是一次公开的战略转向。天医宗内部并非铁板一块——柳玄虽然是少宗主，但他上面还有三位太上长老，其中至少有一位是传统派，认为凡人不配与修士并列署名。如果他们想阻止合作，最简单的办法就是证明秦川“来历不明，不可合作”。
第三方：上界刑天殿。楚云霆虽然放过了秦川，但刑天殿不止一位执刑使。密报事件之后，上界对青山村的关注不会因为楚云霆的沉默而消退。如果上界绕过楚云霆另派他人调查，来的人可能比楚云霆更难对付。
还有第四方。秦川在纸上画了一个问号——那些他还没想到的势力。中界的水比青山村深得多，能在中界布下情报网的势力远不止这几家。
他将草纸卷起来，点燃烧掉。火焰在铜盆里跳动了几下，吞没了那些墨迹未干的推演。他盯着最后一片灰烬被气流卷起又落下，然后走到竹楼外面，沿着药田小径往苏木槿的住处走去。

> Chapter 81 Uncle Zhao’s Advice (Page 1)
On the evening of the third day after Jiansui's summons, Qin Chuan was comparing the list of the third batch of medicinal materials for mortals sent by Shen Qingdai in the workshop, when Jiansui in his arms suddenly became hot again. This time it wasn't Uncle Zhao's voice - it was a line of very faint golden characters that appeared on the bead. The handwriting was scrawled, as if it had been written directly on the smooth surface with a finger in a hurry.
"Someone is checking your origins. More than one party. Be careful."
Qin Chuan stared at this line of writing for a long time. Uncle Zhao's causal network has been broken by 70%. Being able to transmit such specific information across thousands of miles means that the old man has used the only remaining core restriction. The weight of this message is self-evident.
He put down the list of medicinal ingredients and walked to the window. Dusk was getting darker in the medicine field, and several disciples who had returned late were walking across the field ridges carrying lanterns, and their laughter could be faintly heard. The superficial peace in Baicao Valley was still maintained, but this piece of information from Uncle Zhao made him realize that his information advantage was being exploited by his opponents.
He is in the light and the enemy is in the dark. The other party is checking his origins. But what the other party wants to know is not who Qin Chuan is - but who is standing behind Qin Chuan. Lao Lu's named disciple, a Class A client with no shortage of money, a specially appointed researcher of the Baicao Valley owner - each of these identities is a protection, but each level is also a leak of information. The opponent only needs to peel off all his protective layers one by one to reveal his true trump card: a soul that does not belong to this world, and a container with the final fragment sealed in his body.
Qin Chuan walked to the table, spread out a new piece of tissue paper, and began to list the forces that might be investigating him.
The first party: Shen Hemian, the elder of Dantang. The motive is the most direct - Qin Chuan's existence has shaken Dantang's academic authority in Baicao Valley. Shen Qingdai's research direction made breakthrough progress due to Qin Chuan's guidance, which made Shen Hemian both happy and embarrassed in front of his granddaughter. He has the ability to secretly investigate Qin Chuan's origins through Dantang's channels, but because of this, he is the least dangerous party - his investigation will definitely not touch the bottom line of Samsara Sword Master and Qian Buque, because he cannot afford to offend those two.
The second party: the forces within the Tianyi Sect that oppose Liu Xuan. Liu Xuan's acceptance of Qin Chuan's cooperation proposal at the closing banquet was a public strategic shift for the Tianyi Sect. The Heavenly Medicine Sect is not monolithic - although Liu Xuan is the young sect leader, there are three supreme elders above him, at least one of whom is a traditionalist and believes that mortals are not worthy of being signed alongside monks. If they want to prevent cooperation, the easiest way is to prove that Qin Chuan has "unknown origins and cannot cooperate."
Third party: Xingtian Palace in the upper realm. Although Chu Yunting let Qin Chuan go, there was more than one executioner in the Xingtian Palace. After the secret report incident, the upper world's attention to Qingshan Village will not fade because of Chu Yunting's silence. If the upper realm bypasses Chu Yunting and sends someone else to investigate, the person who comes may be more difficult to deal with than Chu Yunting.
There is also a fourth party. Qin Chuan drew a question mark on the paper - the forces he had not thought of yet. The water in the middle realm is much deeper than that in Qingshan Village, and there are far more forces than these that can set up intelligence networks in the middle realm.
He rolled up the tissue paper and burned it. The flames danced a few times in the copper basin, engulfing the deductions that were still stained with ink. He stared at the last piece of ashes being picked up and dropped by the air current, then walked outside the bamboo building and walked along the medicine field path to Su Mujin's residence.
